# Recess 4 Grownups Travel

> > Faith-based travel experiences specializing in Catholic pilgrimages and curated group tours to Europe and the Holy Land.

Recess 4 Grownups Travel organizes spiritual journeys and group travel experiences, with a focus on Catholic pilgrimage tours led by clergy like Father Tim Nadolski. The company offers trips to sacred destinations including the Vatican, Holy Land, Ireland's Marian shrines, and European cultural sites, along with specialty cruises and comprehensive travel preparation resources.
